# Multi-Hyphen Skill Name

This is a test skill to verify that skill names with multiple hyphens are properly supported throughout the system.

## When to Use

Use this skill to test hyphenated skill name support.

## Guidelines

- Skill names can contain multiple hyphens
- Hyphens can appear anywhere in the middle of the name
- But names cannot start or end with hyphens
